name: opto-input
prompt: Build an isolated input stage: a 12 V signal drives the LED side of an optocoupler through a series resistor, and the phototransistor side pulls an ESP32 GPIO low, with a pull-up resistor from the GPIO net to 3.3 V.
notes: Tests four-pin opto orientation (A/K on the input loop, C/E on the MCU loop) and two resistors doing two jobs. Emitter to MCU ground is the low-side convention the knowledge page documents.
